mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_device_token ( user_id, platform, token, token_hash, app_id, device_name, enabled, last_registered_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{platform}, #{token}, #{tokenHash}, #{appId}, #{deviceName}, '1', sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate() ) on duplicate key update user_id = values(user_id), token = values(token), app_id = values(app_id), device_name = values(device_name), enabled = '1', last_registered_time = sysdate(), disabled_time = null, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update sys_user_device_token set enabled = '0', disabled_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where platform = #{platform} and token_hash = #{tokenHash} and enabled = '1'
mapper.select: select token_id, user_id, platform, token, token_hash, app_id, device_name, enabled, last_registered_time, disabled_time, create_time, update_time from sys_user_device_token where user_id = #{userId} and enabled = '1' order by token_id
